blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—No player won the ₱277.99 million Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot and the ₱10 million Lotto 6/42 jackpot on Saturday, October 17, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office. Grand Lotto 6/55 draw result: 09-51-33-49-04-1 Jackpot prize: ₱277.99 million Lotto 6/42 draw result: 05-28-24-09-18-10 Jackpot prize: ₱10 million The 6D Lotto draw produced the winning combination 8-5-6-5-6-9, with a jackpot prize of ₱627,364.20. No ticket holder won the jackpot.
